title: [Hiring] (Remote) Long-form or short-form video editors for anime jewelry | $1,000-$2,000/month
description:
I'm hiring remote video editors for ongoing work with an anime-inspired jewelry brand.

One part of the work is aesthetic long-form YouTube editing in the style of tppo. I need someone who can shape a story, control pacing, and use motion graphics, sound, and visual details without making the edit feel cluttered.

The other part is short-form content for Meta ads. I need editors who understand hooks, product-focused pacing, clean captions, and how to make jewelry look interesting within the first few seconds.

You can specialize in long-form or short-form. There is no requirement to be equally good at both. I may hire multiple people.

The budget is $1,000-$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, availability, and workload. Scope will be agreed in advance, and the hourly equivalent will not be below $15 USD.

To apply, please DM me and include:

  1. Whether you're interested in long-form, short-form, or both

  2. Your portfolio or resume

  3. Your two best relevant samples, including complete videos if you're applying for long-form

  4. What you personally handled in each sample

  5. Your rate

  6. Your availability, realistic monthly capacity, and typical turnaround

  7. The editing software you use

  8. Any relevant anime, jewelry, fashion, ecommerce, YouTube, or Meta ads experience

Please include all eight points so I can review everyone fairly. Please apply by DM rather than in the comments.
